Refitting

1. Undo the bolts fixing the rigid coolant pipe between the engine oil heat exchanger and the E.G.R. system water/exhaust gas heat exchanger.

2. Loosen the bands, disconnect the flexible pipes (2a) and remove the rigid coolant pipe between the engine oil heat exchanger and the E.G.R. system water/exhaust gas heat exchanger (2b).

Recover the coolant which comes out in a suitable container.

Refitting

Removing

Connect the flexible pipes to the rigid coolant pipe between the engine oil heat exchanger and the E.G.R. system water/exhaust gas heat exchanger and tighten the bands.

Tighten the bolts fixing the rigid coolant pipe between the engine oil heat exchanger and the E.G.R. system water/exhaust gas heat exchanger.

Refill the engine cooling system with coolant 0010T20 .
